title: The Composable Internet
disclaimer: Proposed compositions; integrations untested; no copied upstream implementation code

recipes.title: Research Trails
recipes.outcome: Find the thing you saw months ago, including the research trail that led to it.
recipes.original_glue: Import, normalize and time-group visits; show source-grounded research sessions; exclude sensitive domains.
recipes.demonstration: Recover one forgotten article and its surrounding tabs.

recipes.title: Saved Into Action
recipes.outcome: Turn forgotten social saves into usable collections such as recipes, tutorials and trips.
recipes.original_glue: Import permitted saved-content records; route by intent; preserve original links and uncertainty.
recipes.demonstration: Convert ten saved travel posts into an editable map.

recipes.title: Exit Audit
recipes.outcome: Know exactly what you'll keep and lose when moving a library out of a cloud platform.
recipes.original_glue: Make an export inventory, preview import fidelity, verify counts and metadata after migration.
recipes.demonstration: A Google Photos Takeout-to-Immich migration report with mismatches.

recipes.title: Skill Safety Passport
recipes.outcome: A human-readable safety and compatibility card for installable AI agent skills.
recipes.original_glue: Unify specification checks and security reports; never execute untrusted skills in the analyzer.
recipes.demonstration: A clear before-install report for three public skills.

recipes.title: Model Choice Lab
recipes.outcome: Choose a model by actual task performance, latency, privacy and cost.
recipes.original_glue: Run the same fixed tasks against configured models and export repeatable, labeled comparisons.
recipes.demonstration: Compare three models on one user's coding task with a traceable rubric.

recipes.title: Open Source Opportunity Radar
recipes.outcome: Discover recurring unmet needs hidden inside existing software ecosystems.
recipes.original_glue: Connect issues and releases to existing alternatives; produce cited opportunity briefs, not imaginary TAM.
recipes.demonstration: Three defensible opportunities in one technical domain.

recipes.title: Repo Cinema
recipes.outcome: Turn a software release into a short, art-directed before/after demonstration.
recipes.original_glue: Use explicit demonstration scripts and verified screenshots; render shareable visuals without claiming untested functionality.
recipes.demonstration: A 15-second release film from a real PR.

recipes.title: Brand Constellation
recipes.outcome: Show where brands converge, compete and distinguish themselves, visually and verbally.
recipes.original_glue: Compare design-system data across a declared sample; annotate observed messaging and avoid claiming AI authorship.
recipes.demonstration: An explorable cluster of 20 websites with transparent methodology.

recipes.title: Own Your Feed
recipes.outcome: Read trusted sources and public social feeds with ranking rules you control.
recipes.original_glue: Expose user-editable ordering and discovery rules; support reliable feeds before unstable platform adapters.
recipes.demonstration: Publish and share a portable feed recipe.

recipes.title: Your Data, Explained
recipes.outcome: Explore what account exports actually contain and what they do not.
recipes.original_glue: Parse supported exports locally; present a plain-language inventory and data caveats.
recipes.demonstration: Explore one export without sending private content to a server.

recipes.title: AI Memory Suitcase
recipes.outcome: Take selected context between assistants without bringing along your entire history.
recipes.original_glue: Implement selective context packs, provenance, and explicit recipient permissions; document limitations of revocation.
recipes.demonstration: Switch between two compatible assistants using an approved context pack.

recipes.title: Local Media Desk
recipes.outcome: Turn a recording into transcripts, clips, captions and structured notes on your machine.
recipes.original_glue: Build a single-use workflow around existing encoders and speech tools; disclose hardware needs.
recipes.demonstration: A recorded interview becomes transcript plus three shareable clips.

recipes.title: No-Cloud Document Desk
recipes.outcome: Search and transform private documents without requiring an external upload.
recipes.original_glue: Use file extraction, full-text index and optional local inference; make answer sources inspectable.
recipes.demonstration: Find and quote a passage from a private PDF bundle offline.

recipes.title: Personal Publishing Switch
recipes.outcome: Publish to your own domain first, then distribute compatible content across networks.
recipes.original_glue: Provide a guided ownership-first publishing setup with reusable content export.
recipes.demonstration: Publish one post to a personal site and a supported social channel.

recipes.title: Website Receipts
recipes.outcome: Prove when public product claims, policies or prices changed.
recipes.original_glue: Preserve dated snapshots and source URLs, generate careful diff reports and distinguish uncertainty.
recipes.demonstration: A sourced timeline of a published policy change.

recipes.title: Home AI Fit Test
recipes.outcome: Show what real AI workloads a user's devices can run before they spend money.
recipes.original_glue: Combine hardware inventory with model recommendations and separate multi-job scheduling from model sharding.
recipes.demonstration: An evidence-labeled workload compatibility report for two devices.

recipes.title: Software Exit Guide
recipes.outcome: Discover open replacements for a proprietary workflow and estimate migration friction.
recipes.original_glue: Turn lists into task-oriented migration plans, with backups and explicit unsupported features.
recipes.demonstration: A migration path for one common document workflow.

recipes.title: Community-in-a-Box
recipes.outcome: Give a small group a portable site, events, proposals and member resources.
recipes.original_glue: Offer one constrained starter template and optional integrations instead of bundling multiple huge platforms.
recipes.demonstration: An independent group launches a usable public site with governance links.

recipes.title: Public Data Stories
recipes.outcome: Turn open datasets into source-linked, understandable visual stories.
recipes.original_glue: Template data sourcing, caveats and exportable interactive narratives.
recipes.demonstration: An animated, reproducible story from one public dataset.

recipes.title: Agent Receipts
recipes.outcome: Make agent runs independently inspectable: actual actions, changes and test results.
recipes.original_glue: Normalize tool-call and test evidence, preserve redaction controls and never fabricate a run log.
recipes.demonstration: Replay an agent's browser actions and inspect the resulting Git changes.

recipes.title: Attention Receipt
recipes.outcome: Show the outside services contacted when a page loads and explain the consequences.
recipes.original_glue: Capture first-party and third-party requests in an authorized browser run; explain limits without inventing tracking intentions.
recipes.demonstration: Compare third-party connections on two publicly accessible websites.

recipes.title: Open Payment Explorer
recipes.outcome: Compare interoperable payment networks through reproducible simulated transactions.
recipes.original_glue: Build a simulator and transparent fee/reconciliation display; never imply settlement is free or universally supported.
recipes.demonstration: A side-by-side simulated route showing costs, errors and reconciliation.

recipes.title: Independent Search Starter
recipes.outcome: Install a useful private search experience without configuring five servers.
recipes.original_glue: Create a supported single-machine deployment and provider-independent model configuration.
recipes.demonstration: Run private metasearch with optional local summarization.

recipes.title: One-Click Knowledge Transfer
recipes.outcome: Move a research workspace between machines and apps, with verification.
recipes.original_glue: Combine structured exports, integrity checks and conflict-aware sync only where needed.
recipes.demonstration: Resume a research workspace on another machine, with matching records.
